title: Talking Logistics: Descartes: From the Dot-Com Era to the AI Era
summary: Talking Logistics' Adrian Gonzalez reflects on more than 25 years of Descartes' growth and innovation, including the recent introduction of the Descartes Agent Control Plane at its 2026 Innovation Forum. Built on the Descartes Global Logistics Network (GLN), the Agent Control Plane represents an important next step in connecting AI agents across applications and trading partners to automate complex logistics workflows with customer-defined controls and human oversight.
body_markdown:
Talking Logistics' Adrian Gonzalez reflects on more than 25 years of Descartes' growth and innovation, including the recent introduction of the Descartes Agent Control Plane at its 2026 Innovation Forum. Built on the Descartes Global Logistics Network (GLN), the Agent Control Plane represents an important next step in connecting AI agents across applications and trading partners to automate complex logistics workflows with customer-defined controls and human oversight.


[Read more on talkinglogistics.com](https://talkinglogistics.com/2026/10/26/descartes-from-the-dot-com-era-to-the-ai-era/)
